function.name: spawn_subagent
function.description: Start one native subagent thread. Returns a subagent_run_id immediately while progress remains visible through ACP updates.

task.description: The task this subagent should work on.

policy.description: Requested tool policy for this subagent.

function.name: list_subagents
function.description: List active or waiting subagent threads by id and status.

function.name: checkout_subagent
function.description: Return a non-blocking snapshot of a subagent thread's status, progress, flow, and latest result.

subagent_run_id.description: The subagent id returned by spawn_subagent.

function.name: wait_subagent
function.description: Wait for the subagent's current turn to finish. If it is already waiting for input, returns immediately.

subagent_run_id.description: The subagent id returned by spawn_subagent.

function.name: send_subagent
function.description: Send another message to a waiting or failed subagent thread. Can interrupt a running turn if interrupt is true.

subagent_run_id.description: The subagent id returned by spawn_subagent.

message.description: The next instruction or message for the subagent.

interrupt.description: Whether to cancel the current running turn before sending this message.

function.name: close_subagent
function.description: Close a subagent thread and cancel any running turn.

subagent_run_id.description: The subagent id returned by spawn_subagent.
